evidence: News flow heading into May 26 is anchored by notable institutional bullish catalysts and oversold recovery sentiment. Most prominently, JPMorgan issued a high-profile note naming cryptocurrencies its preferred alternative asset class and assessing Bitcoin as roughly 28% undervalued relative to fair value. Simultaneously, reports highlight that Wall Street net long positioning in Bitcoin futures reached a new record high, and prominent figures like Ray Dalio reaffirmed preference for Bitcoin over cash and equities. While Bitcoin remains burdened by an unprecedented 8-week red streak, the convergence of institutional dip-buying narratives and potential short-term oversold exhaustion provides a modest upward tilt over the 24-hour horizon.
limitations: Several evidence items were duplicates of the same JPMorgan alternative asset class research note.
Multiple items consisted of YouTube commentary, general commentary (WEF/Davos), or altcoin/CBDC developments irrelevant to 24-hour BTC price action and were excluded.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
